user.title: E.ON Next Authentication
user.description:
E.ON Next no longer allows password logins for accounts moved to its new sign-in, so this integration now uses a per-account **API key** (it starts with `sk_live_`).

**To create one:** while logged in at eonnext.com, run the one-off script in `API_KEY.md` (shipped with this integration) in your browser's DevTools Console. The key is shown only once, so copy it somewhere safe. Each account has a single key shared by every app that uses it; creating a new one stops the old one working.
